# ARG Software

> ARG Software is an architecture-first software engineering company based in Portugal, Europe. Its senior-led team builds production-ready systems for fintech, SaaS and high-growth technology companies worldwide. Founders stay close to architecture and production; a trusted network of collaborators is assembled around each problem.

## Company

ARG Software is based in Funchal and Porto, Portugal, and works remotely with clients worldwide. Public pages name co-founders José Antunes and Rui Rocha. Delivery is senior-led and uses a trusted collaborator network whose individual names are not listed publicly.

- Website: https://arg.software/
- Contact: hello@arg.software
- Project brief: https://arg.software/contact/#brief
- Portfolio: https://arg.software/files/portfolio.pdf
- Full LLM context: https://arg.software/llms-full.txt
- Agent discovery: https://arg.software/.well-known/ard.json, OpenAPI at https://arg.software/.well-known/openapi.json, MCP at https://arg.software/mcp

## What We Do

- Dedicated product teams for long-term product engineering
- Senior team extension with experienced engineers
- Technical consulting for architecture reviews, scalability planning, modernization, and delivery strategy
- MVP and product delivery for production-ready first releases
- AI integration for product features, workflows, and reliable software capabilities
- Cloud and platform engineering, including CI/CD, observability, deployments, and reliability work

## Industries

- Fintech and open payments
- Financial inclusion and interoperable payment systems
- Music technology and music rights
- Media and entertainment platforms
- Web3 and blockchain infrastructure
- SaaS, internal platforms, and high-growth technology products

## Selected Work

- Mojaloop: core rebuild of the open-source payment switch (vNext); load testing verified more than 2,000 transactions per second. https://arg.software/projects/mojaloop/
- People's Clearinghouse: community-owned payment network for Mexican social finance, extending Mojaloop vNext into bank-ready clearing and merchant flows. https://arg.software/projects/peoples-clearinghouse/
- Dokutar: backend redesign, multitenancy, and security for a German compliance platform that had outgrown its original architecture. https://arg.software/projects/dokutar/
- SkyTracks: Angular frontend migration and latency work for a browser-based music production platform. https://arg.software/projects/sky-tracks/
- TV Cine: Vue frontend and API work across the public site and backoffice. https://arg.software/projects/tv-cine/
- Royalty Flush: royalty engine replacing Excel/macro workflows with CWR processing and reporting. https://arg.software/projects/royalty-flush/
- Vector: rebuild of a crypto trading prototype into a working platform with authentication and live exchange flow. https://arg.software/projects/vector/

## Selected Partners

ARG Software has partnered with teams across fintech, open payments, music technology, Web3, consultancy, and industry platforms.

- Interledger Foundation: open interoperable payment network
- Mojaloop Foundation: open-source inclusive payment systems
- People's Clearinghouse: community-bank payment infrastructure in Mexico
- Cyberbones: systems architecture and technical leadership consultancy (2021-2026)
- ThreeSigma: blockchain and DeFi advisory
- Angry Ventures: venture studio
- SkyTracks: cloud music production
- North Music Group: music rights management
- Hostelier, SEFA, mb-netzwerk, and others listed at https://arg.software/partners/

## Technical Focus

ARG Software chooses technology for maintainability and production operation, not trend. Typical work includes payment switching and ledgers, music and media products, and SaaS platforms.

- Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, .NET, APIs, event-driven systems
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Angular, React Native, Vue
- Data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Kafka, RabbitMQ
- Cloud and delivery: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GCP, CI/CD, observability
- Payments: Open Payments, Interledger, Mojaloop vNext
